criteria.name: Neural Network Design & Implementation
criteria.guidance: Assess appropriate architecture, implementation, activation/loss/optimizer choices, and justified design.

criteria.name: Data Preparation & Training
criteria.guidance: Assess preprocessing, class imbalance handling if relevant, train/validation split, training configuration, and reproducibility.

criteria.name: Model Evaluation & Overfitting Analysis
criteria.guidance: Assess appropriate metrics, learning curves or validation analysis, generalization, and mitigation of overfitting.

criteria.name: ML vs DL Comparison
criteria.guidance: Assess fair comparison against prior ML models using consistent splits/metrics and a justified conclusion.

criteria.name: NLP Implementation & Findings
criteria.guidance: Assess text preparation, suitable NLP features/model, evaluation, examples/findings, and limitations.
